description: Adds a table value selected by an index in the structure to a byte field. On overflow it clears the field, advances a pointer through a buffer with wrap-around, and inverts the byte it points to.

key: Brutal - Paws of Fury (demo) (1995)(GameTek).adf +$8000 run at $0317E0 (20672 bytes, matched to executed PCs):0:4F88
name: advance_counter_and_copy_entry
description: Increments a counter in the structure, and when the incremented value matches the input word it copies that word into two places, reads a thirty-two-byte table entry selected by the counter, and copies its fields into the structure.

key: Brutal - Paws of Fury (demo) (1995)(GameTek).adf +$8000 run at $0317E0 (20672 bytes, matched to executed PCs):0:5022
name: select_nibble_table_value
description: Reads a nibble from a flag byte, taking the high or low half according to a state byte, and uses it to index a table. It searches up to thirty-six entries for the first one not above a stored value and copies the matching value into a short field.

name: load_hunk_sections_at_entry
description: Program entry that calls AllocMem, FindTask and FreeMem and steps through hunk-style records, comparing their type codes with the loader's hunk values and copying section data. The tail of the routine decodes as bad instruction data, so the final part is not valid code.

name: stub_empty_return_routine
description: Contains only a return instruction and has no visible behaviour. It is an empty stub in the program.

name: countdown_delay_loop
description: Decrements the data register in a loop until it reaches zero, acting as a timing delay. It touches no memory.

name: unpack_backward_run_length
description: Decodes a packed byte stream by writing output backwards from an end pointer, copying runs of earlier bytes and handling repeat counts of three, four and seven. It stops when the output pointer reaches the start of the buffer.

name: step_byte_with_space_wrap
description: Decrements a byte in the data register a counted number of times, replacing a wrapped zero value with a space character. It makes no memory accesses and returns with only that register changed.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Contains only bytes that do not decode as instructions, so the routine is data rather than code. Execution reaching it would hit invalid instructions.

name: run_entry_setup_sequence
description: Program entry that looks up the running task and calls a sequence of library and helper routines to set up state. It runs a setup step only when a flag is set, then performs cleanup calls and returns zero, using Amiga message-port calls on the way.

name: wait_for_vblank_then_update
description: Spins until the vertical blank request bit in the interrupt request register is set, clears it, then calls seven helper routines in order.

name: wait_vblank_run_four_steps
description: Repeatedly waits for the vertical blank request bit, clears it and calls four helper routines, looping while the word in the data register stays zero.

name: dispatch_by_mode_until_clear
description: Repeatedly picks one of two helper groups by a mode word, each group calling three helpers, and loops while a second word stays nonzero.

name: call_four_until_flag_set
description: Calls four helper routines repeatedly until a shared word equals minus one.

name: call_seven_then_optional_helper
description: Calls seven helpers repeatedly while a shared word is nonzero, then calls one more helper, with an extra call when a mode word equals two.

name: initialise_mode_and_helpers
description: Clears a mode word, calls thirteen helper routines, stores 254 in a shared word, then calls six more helpers. It references the FORM identifier string.

name: initialise_tile_graphics_state
description: Calls helpers to prepare graphics and state, sets a group of position, size and timer words to fixed starting values, and copies configuration words into table slots. It references the tile graphics file jailtiles1.iff.

name: reset_level_state_and_flags
description: Sets a wait value and clears several state flags and counters, makes fifteen helper calls and stores 254 in a shared word. It references the tile graphics file jailtiles2.iff and the map files jailcustback.map and jailcustbrick.map.

name: poll_input_and_decrement_counter
description: Decrements a countdown word and resets a state pair when it runs out, then calls helpers and polls a helper result until it is zero. A second loop polls the fire-button port and returns when the bit pattern changes.

name: scan_entries_for_state_two
description: Makes one helper call, then walks thirteen fixed-size records and calls a helper for each record whose state word equals two.

name: scan_entries_for_state_one
description: Walks thirteen fixed-size records and, for each record whose state word equals one, calls two helpers in order.

name: decrement_counters_set_flag_bits
description: Visits three counters from the last to the first: a zero counter has its single-bit mask stored into a shared word, while a nonzero counter is decremented by one.

name: reset_state_when_counter_expires
description: When a signed counter is nonnegative it decrements the counter, and when it reaches zero it clears one state word, sets another to all ones and sets the counter to minus one.

name: expire_timer_and_clear_pair
description: Decrements a timer word while it is nonzero, and when it reaches zero clears two state words and makes a helper call. It makes two more helper calls on every pass.

name: reload_counter_on_zero_flag
description: When bit four of the input word is set, it decrements a counter, and when the counter reaches zero it reloads it to twenty and calls a helper.

name: update_position_from_mouse_delta
description: Reads the mouse movement counter, computes signed horizontal and vertical deltas from the previous reading, and either moves a group of coordinates with clamping or accumulates the deltas with saturation and writes derived outputs.

name: set_positions_from_flags
description: When a timer word is zero it calls a helper, derives two position words from base coordinates and sets the timer to seventy-four. When another flag bit is set and its timer is zero, it does the same for a second group and sets that timer to seventy-five.

name: dispatch_when_state_two
description: When the mode word equals two, it calls one helper for each of three nonzero flag bytes, then calls two more helpers. Otherwise it returns unchanged.

name: clear_expired_timer_flags
description: Clears three flag bytes whose timer words are negative or above 209 when a status bit is clear, and calls a helper once all three flags are zero.

name: initialise_level_positions_and_timers
description: Sets a group of position words to 208 and clears a set of flag bytes, then runs a series of helper calls including a loop that repeats while a helper returns nonzero. It also sets timer and offset words, and when a level word is nonzero it starts a sequence of counters at fixed values.

name: run_setup_helper_sequence
description: Runs seven helper calls, repeats one helper call until it returns zero, then makes four more helper calls. It references the FORM identifier string.

name: decrement_and_clear_flag_word
description: Decrements a word at offset 6 of the structure pointed to by the address register, calls a helper, and clears a shared flag word when a set of comparisons on two status words holds.

name: update_record_flags_by_position
description: When a shared status bit is clear, it walks ten-word records until a terminator, marking each record as inside or outside a rectangle and calling helpers for each change. When the bit is set it applies one helper pass to the last marked record.

name: copy_sprite_fields_and_constants
description: Copies a group of position and size words from the structure into fixed RAM words, choosing between two field pairs by a flag bit. It then stores the constants 208, 320 and five and calls a helper.

name: dispatch_on_mode_value
description: Calls one helper when the mode word equals one and a different helper otherwise.

name: dispatch_command_selector
description: When a status bit is set, it switches on a command selector from one to sixteen, setting mode and level words or calling helpers for each case, then clears the selector. It references four map file names.

name: dispatch_state_byte_handlers
description: When a status bit is set, it dispatches on a state byte from one to seven, running a short sequence of helper calls for each state, then clears the state byte. It references two map files.

name: program_blitter_block_copies
description: When a mode word equals two, it programs the blitter registers and copies a block five times at a fixed offset, repeating the setup with a second offset when bit thirteen of the input word is set. It waits for a status bit before each copy.

name: advance_timer_and_counters
description: Decrements a timer word and, when it expires, reloads it to two and steps up to three counters, wrapping each one past a threshold. Which counters step and their thresholds depend on bits of the input word.

name: step_movement_with_collision_checks
description: Steps two coordinates in a loop by a stored velocity, checking tile and object codes at each step. It sets a direction word to plus or minus one at two boundary values and writes sprite state words during each iteration.

name: check_flag_and_reset_counter
description: When a flag is set and its counter, advanced by two, passes 189, it either calls helpers and adds ten to a word at offset 8 when a position difference lies within a signed range, or clears the flag once the counter exceeds 209.

name: update_timers_for_two_entries
description: Decrements a position timer for one entry by a stored step and calls a helper, clearing its flag and resetting the timer when it goes negative. A second entry advances by its own step when its flag is set, with a helper call at each step.

name: clear_sixteen_state_words
description: Writes zero to sixteen words of a fixed state block, advancing eight bytes between writes.

name: step_entries_with_tile_bounce
description: When a mode word equals two and a flag is set, it walks a zero-terminated list of four-word entries, moving each vertically by its velocity. It reverses the velocity when the tile lookup under the entry returns zero or fifteen, and calls a helper for each entry it moves.

name: advance_counter_run_six_calls
description: When the word at offset 10 is at most the word at offset 8, it increments the word at offset 6, calls a helper and adds one thousand to offset 10. It then calls a helper six times in a loop.

name: call_helper_twelve_times
description: Calls a helper routine twelve times in total, arranged as two loops of five calls followed by two single calls. It does no other work.

name: write_four_byte_glyph_cell
description: When a count field is nonzero, it computes a cell address from two index fields and writes four fixed bytes there, adjusting three of them with values from the structure. It then copies the four bytes to a location 548 bytes later.

name: sync_changed_word_field
description: When the word at offset 4 differs from the word at offset 14, it copies the first into the second and calls two helpers.

name: configure_blitter_source_rows
description: When a count field is nonzero, it writes the blitter modulo, mask and size registers from the structure, then loops over a short count, waiting for the blitter to go idle before advancing its source pointer.

name: copy_five_blitter_rows
description: Computes two destination addresses from the input position and programs the blitter registers, then starts five copies whose source pointer advances by thirty-two bytes and destination by the plane step each time.

name: copy_tile_rows_via_blitter
description: Programs the blitter for a copy at a position computed from the input registers, then runs five blitter starts, advancing the source by thirty-two bytes and each destination by the plane step.

name: update_tile_buffer_cells
description: When a mode word equals two and a countdown byte expires, it walks a tile buffer of twenty-six rows by thirteen bytes. It calls a helper for each nonzero cell and increments that cell's counter, resetting it to zero when a modulo-six test passes.

name: handle_mode_input_actions
description: When a status bit is clear, it branches on a mode word: mode two checks two pairs of flag bytes and calls a helper when a counter is set, while mode one calls helpers depending on whether a position lies within a rectangle. When the status bit is set it marks the mode as minus one.

name: check_button_and_position_range
description: When the mode word equals one, the right-button port bit is clear, and two position words fall inside fixed ranges, it calls one of two helpers depending on a flag.

name: wait_fire_after_cell_index
description: Computes a cell index from two position words and stores it in a shared word, calls two helpers, then polls the fire-button port until its bit is set.

name: compute_offset_then_wait_input
description: Computes a shared offset from a multiplier and two position words plus a constant of 260, calls a helper, then polls the fire-button port until its bit is set.

name: update_map_nibble_cell
description: Computes a map cell address from two position words and a stored plane index, then clears or merges the low or high nibble of that byte according to a mode value. It calls helpers when the cell changes.

name: delay_when_mode_thirty_one
description: When a mode word equals thirty-one, it runs a short delay loop of thirteen iterations, and otherwise it returns at once.

name: update_map_tile_byte
description: Computes a map byte address from two position words and a plane index, and when the stored byte differs from a value derived from a state word, it writes the new value and calls a helper.

name: clear_map_cell_and_notify
description: Computes a map byte address from position and plane values, and when the byte is nonzero it zeroes it and calls a helper.

name: clear_map_cell_with_refresh
description: Computes a map byte address from the same position and plane values, and when the byte is nonzero it zeroes it and calls two helpers.

name: call_two_helpers_in_order
description: Calls two helper routines in sequence and returns. It touches no data directly.

name: call_two_helpers_then_return
description: Calls two helper routines in order and returns with no other work.

name: fill_grid_block_sprites
description: Walks a grid of cells, writing a fixed block of parameters into the output registers for each cell and calling a helper that supplies the next cell position.

name: draw_grid_tiles_with_helper
description: Walks a small grid of tile positions, writing fixed tile parameters for each cell and calling a helper that supplies the next position.

name: initialise_record_fields_and_call
description: Stores a base address and an offset computed from an index, sets a set of fixed fields and a frame size, then calls a helper.

name: call_three_helpers_in_order
description: Calls three helper routines one after another with no other work.

name: initialise_record_fields_alt
description: Performs the same record setup as its neighbour with a different frame size, then calls a helper.

name: call_four_helpers_by_value
description: Calls a helper four times whichever way a word at the address register compares with two, so both branches make the same four calls.

name: call_two_helpers_when_idle
description: When a global mode word is zero it calls two helpers, otherwise it returns unchanged.

name: call_two_helpers_when_clear
description: When a global flag word is zero it calls two helpers, otherwise it returns unchanged. It is the same test as its neighbour.

name: call_eight_helpers_when_zero
description: When a global mode word equals zero it calls a helper eight times in a row, otherwise it returns unchanged.

name: store_inputs_into_record_block
description: Copies a value from one global into a record, writes fixed extent words, stores the incoming register values into the record and calls a helper.

name: call_four_helpers_in_order
description: Calls four helper routines in sequence and returns. It references the CLR PILL text.

name: call_single_helper_then_return
description: Calls one helper routine and returns with no other operation.

name: call_single_helper_second
description: Calls one helper routine and returns with no other operation, identical to its neighbours.

name: store_inputs_and_constant_block
description: Stores fixed zero and extent words in a record, copies the two address-register inputs into two record fields, and calls a helper.

name: clear_record_and_store_inputs
description: Clears five record words, sets extent words to fixed values, stores the two address-register inputs into the record, and calls a helper.

name: call_single_helper_third
description: Calls one helper routine and returns with no other operation.

name: call_single_helper_fourth
description: Calls one helper routine and returns with no other operation.

name: install_interrupt_handler_and_check
description: Stores a constant and a handler address into shared globals, calls a library function through a table entry, and when the result is nonzero it calls two more library functions that use the interrupt-enable register.

name: install_interrupt_with_retry
description: Stores a constant and a handler address into shared globals, calls a library function, and when it returns nonzero calls two more library functions, repeating that pair once more if a second call also returns nonzero. It references the map file names for the jail custom and brick layouts.

name: allocate_block_and_store_handler
description: Calls AllocMem through a library table entry, then stores a handler address and a constant into shared globals.

name: clear_two_memory_regions
description: Clears two memory regions byte by byte with countdown loops, writing zero to every byte in each region.

name: advance_counter_below_limit
description: Increments a counter while the next value stays under one hundred and then calls four helpers. Otherwise it calls a single helper.

name: decrement_counter_with_fallback
description: Decrements a counter and clamps it at zero. When it goes below zero it calls one helper, otherwise it calls four helpers.

name: increment_limited_level_counter
description: Increments a counter while the next value stays below nine and calls a helper. Otherwise it calls a different helper.

name: decrement_counter_and_branch
description: Decrements a counter and clamps it at zero, calling one helper when it underflowed and another helper otherwise.

name: call_helper_twice
description: Sets a short counter to one and calls a helper twice in a loop, then returns.

name: clear_flag_bit_over_records
description: Clears bit one in a byte field of each record in a chain, calling a helper after each one. It advances twenty bytes to the next record while its word stays nonnegative.

name: clear_flag_bit_records_alt
description: Performs the same chain walk as its neighbour, clearing bit one and calling a helper for each record.

name: dispatch_state_update_by_step
description: Dispatches on a step counter from one to thirteen, updating position, flag and timer words for each step and calling helpers for sprite and state setup. Some steps depend on bits of the input word.

name: clear_tile_buffer_and_wait
description: Clears a buffer of 338 bytes through a pointer, calling two helpers and writing a constant for each cell with a nonzero high nibble other than fifteen. It then repeats a helper call until it returns zero.

name: store_masked_state_when_idle
description: When a flag word is zero and the low nibble of the input is nonzero, it copies two words from the pointer and stores a masked word and a small value derived from the input. It returns the input unchanged.

name: process_tile_interaction
description: Looks up a tile code at the position given by the address register and, for codes in a fixed range, updates a counter, a state word and tile values while calling helpers. A counter reaching zero triggers a state change, and special codes take additional branches.

name: reflect_velocity_on_edges
description: Negates a pair of velocity words when a masked offset from the second pointer's position indicates an edge hit, using the sign of each velocity to decide. It returns the input registers unchanged.

name: check_overlap_and_reflect
description: Walks a zero-terminated table of entries and tests whether each overlaps a bounding box. On overlap it calls a helper and flips the velocity components of the entry according to which edge was hit.

name: update_counter_pair_by_index
description: Calls a helper, then selects one of four cases by an index. Two cases increment a field capped at two, and two decrement a field that is forced to one when it reaches zero.

name: set_direction_by_state_index
description: When a flag bit is set it clears a related flag and resets timing words. Otherwise it flips the sign of a velocity word under two checks, then writes three direction words chosen by a state index from zero to seven and calls a helper.

name: set_tile_collision_flags
description: Chooses tile collision flag offsets from a base value according to the current tile type and a secondary tile value. It clears some flags in certain cases and calls helpers when a bit in the input word is set.

name: scroll_offsets_until_done
description: Adds sixteen to a shared scroll offset, then repeatedly moves four shared position words by one step each and calls helpers until the second helper returns zero.

name: animate_cells_until_done
description: Repeatedly steps four shared words in opposing directions and calls helpers until one helper returns zero, then subtracts sixteen from a shared offset.

name: initialise_state_and_helpers
description: Calls helpers to clear buffers and wait, sets a group of position words to 208 and flag bytes to zero, repeats one helper call until it returns zero, then sets timers and a counter and makes several more helper calls.

name: call_helper_grid_loop
description: Calls a helper once for each cell of a thirteen-by-thirteen nested loop, then returns the input registers unchanged.

name: call_helper_thirteen_times
description: Calls a helper thirteen times in a countdown loop, then returns the input registers unchanged.

name: call_helper_grid_loop_alt
description: Performs the same thirteen-by-thirteen nested helper calls as its neighbour and returns the input registers unchanged.

name: copy_tile_row_bytes
description: Copies 338 bytes from a source row, located by a stored index and a fixed row size, to a destination pointer read from the structure. It returns the input data register unchanged.

name: clear_tile_buffer_and_scan
description: Clears a grid of tile bytes of twenty-six rows by thirteen cells, then scans a second buffer cell by cell. It counts nonzero high nibbles, calls helpers and writes four words into a list for one specific nibble value, and sets a completion flag when the scan ends.

name: decode_level_map_cells
description: Walks a grid of twenty-six rows by thirteen cells over a map buffer, calling a helper for each cell whose nibbles are nonzero and accumulating the returned values into the position counters. It returns the combined final counters.

name: call_two_helpers_keep_result
description: Calls two helper routines and returns the data register value it was given.

name: call_helper_four_times
description: Calls a helper four times in a countdown loop and returns the input registers unchanged.

name: parse_control_byte_stream
description: Reads a stream of signed bytes: a nonnegative byte ends a run, a sentinel value is skipped, and any other negative byte calls a helper repeatedly while its count is nonzero.

name: write_byte_to_buffer
description: Stores the low byte of the data register at the address held in the second address register and returns.

name: initialise_record_block_inputs
description: Stores the two register inputs into shared words, computes an address from a stored index and a table, sets fixed sprite and frame fields in the record addressed by the address register, and calls helpers.

name: start_five_blitter_copies
description: Computes a source address from the inputs and programs the blitter control words, then starts five copies. It waits for the blitter to go idle before each copy and advances the source by the plane step each time.

name: call_helper_two_then_return
description: Calls a helper twice in a loop and returns the input registers unchanged.

name: call_helper_over_zero_string
description: Walks a zero-terminated string, calling a helper for each byte and advancing the pointer to the position the helper returns. It returns the input registers unchanged.

name: copy_or_clear_tilemap_columns
description: For each of five columns, it either clears eight vertically spaced bytes at the destination or copies eight bytes from a source table, according to a bit in a mask. It returns the input registers unchanged.

name: animate_sprite_position_steps
description: Initialises blitter globals, derives position fields from the structure's size and offset words, then loops over a count, reading a blitter address and advancing the position fields on each pass. It waits for the blitter to go idle during each pass.

name: configure_blitter_from_object
description: Programs the blitter control words from the object record, then loops over its step count, waiting for the blitter to go idle and advancing source and destination pointers on each pass.

name: copy_interleaved_word_pairs
description: Copies sixteen words from one source into every other word of a destination table, then copies sixteen words from a second source offset by thirty-two bytes into the remaining positions.

name: scan_for_marker_then_call
description: Advances a pointer two bytes at a time until it finds the four-byte marker that spells BODY, then calls a helper and returns.
